messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — ran a focused sweep on max_tokens_per_batch and queue policies across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 this morning. Dropping raw notes here so we can iterate.

maria: Nice, can you paste the topline numbers? esp A100 vs H100 differences.

alex: Topline summary: A10/T4/L4 are memory-constrained with heavy KV usage; A100/H100 are compute-bound. Recommended starting defaults (per-GPU): T4 -> max_batch_tokens=1500, max_batch_size=32; A10 -> 2500 / 48; L4 -> 2000 / 40; A100 -> 8000 / 128; H100 -> 12000 / 192. These are conservative — tuned for p95 latency under mixed workloads.

chris: Where did KV-cache behavior influence those numbers?

alex: Two workload patterns: short-chat (avg request 256 tokens) and long-context (avg 4k with KV). For long-context, effective packable tokens drop ~20-30% because many requests already have large KV footprints and we hit memory pressure. On T4 specifically we saw OOM when batch aggregated >6k total tokens if many requests had long KV.

jun: Can you paste the profiling output that shows kernel selection impact?

alex: Sure — pasted small snippet from profiler: 

```
[PROFILE] gpu=A100 kernel=flash_attn_fp16 throughput=4200 tok/s
[PROFILE] gpu=H100 kernel=cuda_attention_v2 throughput=5300 tok/s
[PROFILE] gpu=T4 kernel=matmul_slow fallback throughput=900 tok/s
regression: commit 7f3a20 switched kernel selector -> fallback on T4
```

That last line is important — we lost the matmul_fast path on T4 which caused a ~2.5x drop.

daria: That T4 drop was the change I landed yesterday (I upstreamed a selector simplification). Looks like we under-tested T4. My bad — we should gate it.

alex: Agreed. Proposal: add per-GPU thresholds to kernel_selector config. Only do fallback if mem>Y or qps>X. We should also introduce a token_budget_target per-GPU which caps how many tokens we will try to assemble into a single batch. If pending queue tokens >= token_budget_target, we flush the batch. This prevents huge packings that blow up tail latency.

maria: Token budget target? give an example.

alex: Example policy: H100 token_budget_target=12_000, A100=8_000, L4=2_000, A10=2_500, T4=1_500. When pending_tokens >= target we stop merging more requests and send the batch. Also keep min_flush_interval=3ms to avoid micro-bursts. This reduced p99 in local tests.

chris: Any concrete p99/p95 diff?

alex: On an A100 8-GPU test with mixed short/long workload, setting token_budget_target=8k reduced p99 from 320ms -> 240ms at ~same throughput (throughput delta <3%). p95 improved ~12%. On T4, lowering the target to 1.5k reduced tail latency but we lose ~6% throughput — tradeoff acceptable for latency-sensitive customers.

jun: Good. We should be careful about throughput-sensitive configs for batchy embedding workloads though. Maybe stratify by route/model.

alex: Yes — implement per-model multipliers. Default multiplier 1.0, heavy-embedding routes can set multiplier=1.6 to favor throughput.

maria: Can we add telemetry so we can iterate? metrics to emit: kernel_id, batch_tokens, kv_hit_rate, batch_input_mem_bytes, p50/p95/p99 per kernel.

alex: On it. Also logging suggestion from daria: add 'kv_memory_ratio' and 'batch_tokens' to trace spans.

daria: Will follow up in PR. Also will revert the T4 selector change behind a feature flag until canary passes.

alex: Plan of action: 1) revert/flag T4 selector change, 2) push per-gpu token_budget defaults and max_batch_size, 3) add kernel_selector thresholds, 4) add telemetry (kernel_id, kv_hit_rate, batch_tokens), 5) run 12h canary in us-west and eu-west collecting p50/p95/p99 + kv stats. If canary looks good, roll to prod.

perf-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary token-budget config -> eng-runtime-canary at 1954328400 :rocket:

daria: Thanks — will open PR for selector + trace fields.

ach: quick note: for the config format today I used this snippet (will put in PR):

```
{
  "gpu_defaults": {
    "T4": {"max_batch_tokens": 1500, "max_batch_size": 32, "token_budget_target": 1500},
    "A10": {"max_batch_tokens": 2500, "max_batch_size": 48, "token_budget_target": 2500},
    "L4": {"max_batch_tokens": 2000, "max_batch_size": 40, "token_budget_target": 2000},
    "A100": {"max_batch_tokens": 8000, "max_batch_size": 128, "token_budget_target": 8000},
    "H100": {"max_batch_tokens": 12000, "max_batch_size": 192, "token_budget_target": 12000}
  },
  "kernel_selector": {"t4_fallback_thresholds": {"mem_pct": 75, "qps": 200}}
}
```

maria: LGTM. Please tag me on the PR and include the perf graphs. :thumbsup:

alex: Will do. Opening the PR now and will attach canary dashboards.

maria: thanks all, nice cleanup.
